Thanks Naomi — technical plan below. I will own the execution and post the audit record.

Summary of execution plan (actionable items):
- Intake & validation (T0): confirm signed DSR, verify account id and list checksum. Done.
- Snapshot (T+10m): create immutable snapshot of current indexes and metadata for internal audit (retained in encrypted archive for 30 days as permitted by policy). Archive ID will be referenced in the checklist.
- KV cache eviction (T+15m): evict any active KV/prefix caches associated with the listed user IDs across the serving cluster in us-west-2. This prevents new served responses from including the prompts/outputs.
- Persistent storage removal (T+30m onward): run targeted delete job to remove records from:
  * prompt-store (primary)
  * output-store (generated outputs)
  * short-term inference logs (ingestion bucket retained <=7 days)
  * runtime debug traces (if any)
- Audit log redaction (T+4h): redact PII from long-term audit logs where possible and tag entries as removed; where redaction would break audit integrity, we will provide an annotated entry explaining the redaction.
- Verification & checksum (T+6h): run verification pass that enumerates zero results for the user IDs and produce per-user confirmation.
- Execution checklist & sign-off (T+8h): produce deletion-execution-checklist.csv with timestamps, operator, job ids, and archive references; email to Umbrella legal and it-ops.

Risk notes and limits:
- Backups: our full backups have a retention policy beyond immediate deletion windows; per contract, removing items from backups requires an exception and can take longer (we will list any items in immutable backups separately).
- Third-party indices: if Umbrella has data mirrored outside Redwood, joint coordination required.

Attachments to final email: deletion-execution-checklist.csv (generated after run), archive reference, and a brief tech note on what was redacted vs removed.

I propose we schedule execution for Monday 2026-09-07 16:00 UTC to align with low-traffic window. Confirm and I'll block the maintenance window.

-Rishi
